findingDetails.title: warnLength can be configured above maxLength, creating a dead warning
findingDetails.evidence: Shape check rejects only non-positive or non-finite warnLength (:193); the maxLength error (:459-461) and the warning (:462-464) make warnLength > maxLength unreachable-before-error. Shipped pair 80/100 is unaffected.
findingDetails.recommendation: When both keys are numbers, add a shape error for warnLength > maxLength (optionally >=) so a dead warning fails closed.

findingDetails.title: Alias canonical values are not validated against scopePattern
findingDetails.evidence: Shape check requires string values only; the alias error (:435-437) can instruct a canonical scope that the same contract then rejects via subject.format when the value fails scopePattern. Shipped values all match and their four target directories exist.
findingDetails.recommendation: When both scopePattern and scopeAliases are present, reject canonical values that do not match the pattern at contract-load time.
